0022600147.text: The Utah Jazz (1-4) host the Portland Trail Blazers (3-1) in the Jazz's sixth game of the season, with Utah on a three-game losing streak, 5th in the Northwest and 12th in the West. Portland, 2nd in the Northwest and 4th in the West, is 2-0 on the road and has won three of its last four, though Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness), Ja Morant (hamstring), and Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery) are out, and Robert Williams III is day-to-day with a knee injury. For Utah, Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), and Trey Alexander (knee bruise) are out, Lauri Markkanen is day-to-day with a wrist injury and a game-time decision, and the teams have not met yet this season, after the Jazz lost all four meetings last season, most recently 124-114 in Portland on March 13.
